rtm_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Requirement, model, architecture, operations, acceptance, and traceability are represented without process-history wording in the outward layer.
R_single(90d)=0.841 is interpreted as approximately 16 percent failure probability; redundancy is credited only where subsystem architecture actually provides it.
Re-running the build preserves slide count/order unless an explicit change request authorizes mutation, and build rules remain machine-readable.

otc_elements.name: Review-board presentation scenario
otc_elements.objective: Verify that an external reviewer can follow outcome -> proof burden -> model -> architecture -> operations -> acceptance without build-process narration.

del_deliverables.name: Reliability engineering pack triage evidence
del_deliverables.description: PPTX plus machine-readable layout rules, regeneration code, QPS bridge manifest, hashes, and audit receipt.
